A draggable, resizable floating chat window. It lazy-loads `react-rnd` (an optional dependency, so consumers of just the inner <Chat> never pull it) and renders the existing <Chat> beneath a drag-handle header with thread switching, a context-badge row and optional tool preferences.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/ai/ChatWindow.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { ChatWindow } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/ai";
```

## Demos

No dedicated Storybook demo is available for this component yet.

The props table documents the component-specific surface. Standard DOM attributes inherited from React, such as `className`, event handlers, and accessibility attributes, may also be accepted when the component's prop type extends a native element.
